VOIDLING_GENERATOR_12 }} A '''Voidling Minion''' is a {{Skill|Combat}} [[Minions|Minion]] that spawns {{MobSprite|Voidling}}s and collects {{Item|Obsidian}}, {{Item|Nether Quartz}}, and {{Item|Enchanted Ender Pearl}}s. '''Voidling Minion''' recipes are unlocked at {{CollectionLink|Enderman Slayer|4}}. A '''Voidling Minion''' equipped with a {{Item|Soulflow Engine}} gives the upgrade a {{Green|3%}} per minion tier increase in the production of {{Item|Raw Soulflow}}. == Usage == === Drops === {{Minion Drops Table}} === Stats === {{MinionStatsTable}} === Layouts === ==== Minion Ideal Layout ==== {{Minion ideal layout|minion=Voidling Minion|ideal=Air (minion)|border=Oak Fence}} === Minion Modifiers === {{Minion Modifiers List|combat}} === Crafting === {{Crafting Usage|Voidling Minion II}} == Obtaining == {{MinionRecipesTable}} == Trivia == * '''Voidling Minion''' was released before a {{Collection|Wolf Slayer|showIcon=1}} specific minion type, while {{Collection|Enderman Slayer|showIcon=1}} was released after {{Collection|Wolf Slayer|showIcon=1}}. * While a {{Item|Revenant Minion}} and a {{Item|Tarantula Minion}} produce 2–5 of the main drop of their respective mobs, a '''Voidling Minion''' produces {{Item|Obsidian|amount=2-3}}. * '''Voidling Minion''' is the only minion type that can directly harvest an enchanted material. * A '''Voidling Minion''' has a chance to say special dialogue, such as "Throw me your summoning eyes and I'll place them!" or "I got 9/9/9 before atoned" in white. * '''Voidling Minion''' is one of the most costly minion types to upgrade. It is outpriced by {{Item|Tarantula Minion}} and {{Item|Inferno Minion}}. * A '''Voidling Minion''' produces mostly mining materials. Despite this, it is not considered a {{Skill|Mining}} Minion and its speed is not buffed by a {{Item|Mithril Crystal}} or {{NPCSprite|Cole}}'s {{AN|Prospection}} perk. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2021/May 31|[[File:Voidling Minion Render.png|26px]] Added '''Voidling Minion''' Tier I-XI.}} {{History|0.20.5| [[Voidling]]s, and by extension this minion, no longer drop [[Byzantium Dye]].}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Slayer/Enderman}} {{Nav/Minions}} [[Category:Slayer Minions]]
